acceptance_predicates.description: A disposable fresh-user run completes install, wizard, benchmark, record, offline replay, and comparison.
Agents, provider, model, authentication method, workloads, and shared defaults are selectable without hidden typing requirements.
The replay leg denies network access and consumes only the newly recorded cassette.
Human-readable and --json receipts identify exact ASB/TUI heads, channel, configuration, workloads, and comparison availability.
Missing authentication, signatures, and key management produce visible development-only warnings and never block.

definition_of_done: Fresh-user runner passes against exact paired main heads.
Independent review accepts the receipt and failure matrix.

gates.description: Install-to-comparison journey passes with offline and unavailable-provider negatives.
